title: When Local Variance Optimality Is Not Enough: RoPE-Aligned Q/K Rotations for Dynamic 4-Bit Quantisation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rotation-based post-training quantisation commonly applies an orthogonal transform across an entire attention head to reduce outlier-induced error. RoPE instead partitions each head into two-dimensional frequency pairs, raising the question of whether a transform respecting this decomposition can improve on full-head mixing. Prior work has established the per-pair rotations that commute with RoPE. We state the converse result that, for distinct frequencies, no other single-head orthogonal map commutes with RoPE. For the head-shared parameterisation used in our experiments, we then derive the rotation angle that minimises the larger channel variance under a pooled-covariance, position-averaged surrogate and verify that the implementation attains its analytic minimum. translated_title: 当局部方差最优性不足时：用于动态4比特量化的RoPE对齐Q/K旋转
translated_abstract: 基于旋转的后训练量化通常会在整个注意力头上应用正交变换，以减少离群值引起的误差。RoPE则将每个头划分为二维频率对，这引发了一个问题：尊重这种分解的变换能否优于全头混合。先前的工作已经确立了与RoPE可交换的每对旋转。我们陈述了逆结果：对于不同频率，没有其他单头正交映射与RoPE可交换。对于实验中使用的头共享参数化，我们推导出在池化协方差、位置平均替代下最小化较大通道方差的旋转角度，并验证实现达到了其解析最小值。所评估的头共享成对配置在测试的动态W4A4KV4设置中并未提高准确性。在四个检查点上，用头共享成对旋转替换全头Hadamard变换并未带来改进。
tldr: 本文证明了与RoPE可交换的旋转仅限于每对频率旋转，但头共享成对旋转在动态4比特量化中无法提升准确性，表明局部方差最优性不足以改善性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that only per-frequency-pair rotations commute with RoPE, yet head-shared pairwise rotations fail to improve accuracy in dynamic 4-bit quantization, showing local variance optimality is insufficient.
